snippet.title: Escape The Backrooms | Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer ☢️
snippet.description:
Escape the Backrooms has no-clipped onto the Nintendo Switch 2, having appeared on the Xbox Series X|S, PC and Xbox Game Pass, and PlayStation 5 in May!

Team up with these new folks using the brand-new cross-platform lobby code system, create new friends and memories, and most importantly, dance around the party table in Level Fun while humming You Day and chugging Almond Water! Oh, and not dying I suppose... 

Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/Escape-the-Backrooms-3135534.html
